label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/insecure-randomness) is TP: Math.random() at line 88 feeds rememberMeKey at line 118, which is used for authentication cookies and sessions - weak PRNG for security-sensitive material is a real vulnerability. Alert 2 (java/xss) is FP: The sinks at lines 128-133 reference rememberMe.getName() and rememberMe.getValue() which resolve to server-generated values (cookieName from class name construction, rememberMeKey from Math.random()), not user-tainted data.

evidence.note: Math.random() generates weak randomness that flows to rememberMeKey used in authentication cookie
